chapter: Image, travel and Black, Brown and Beige
title: The bushel of crabs on the train
summary: A gift of crabs and beer turns into a 3 a.m. feast; Barney and Toby knew how to clean them.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So you went in the train station and the reporter said what?

Here's a present from your friend. And here's a big bushel of crabs. I mean a bushel basket of crabs. And a case of beer. Now, can't nobody -- don't nobody know how to eat them crabs. Duke didn't know how to clean the crabs. Ivie didn't know nothing about cleaning those crabs. Barney knew and Toby knew. That's all. Man, we got to eating the crabs and drinking the beer. Now, this is about 3:00 o'clock in the morning. And man, Duke's standing up there with the rest of the band, he don't know what the hell to do with them, you know. So Duke says, "Hey, yeah, got you covered. So fast as Albert cleaned one of them crabs, Duke would have it or I would have it or Carné would have it, Johnny Hodges would
have it and I'd look around and the guys, everybody got crabs but me. I said, "Oh, no, I ain't going no further."

So I fixed about six or seven of them, you know, they were so big, for myself. Man, after they got the hang of it, them crabs didn't last a minute. And the beer. Now they wanted to help me eat mine. I said, no way. No, no, no way. But that was a lot of good -- so we left there. The reason we left so late in the morning, we had to play in Mobile, Alabama the next night. So we left. So Cootie's home is in Mobile, Alabama. We pulled into Mobile, Alabama, I think it was -- no we played someplace else, I forget where we played before we get to Mobile. I remember we got to Mobile about 3:00 o'clock in the morning. The station's packed, because that's Cootie's home.
